description: Unity mixer, eight inputs summed to one output, with a mute button on each

params.text: Drops that input out of the sum

inputs.text: One of the eight signals summed into the output

outputs.text: The sum of every unmuted input at unity gain, limited to 12V, soft by default; hard clipping on the menu

notes: in averaging mode the divisor counts every connected input, muted or not
menu: Input gain — cuts every input before the mix: Unity, -3dB, -6dB or -12dB
Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Average — divides each output mix by the number of connected inputs instead of summing them
